title: OpenMarcie: Dataset for Multimodal Action Recognition in Industrial Environments

layout.note: Three stacked rounded bands: pale blue on top (applications, chevron, requirements), two grey scenario cards side by side in the middle, pale blue at the bottom (sensor table, chevron, validation tree).

lesson: A dataset paper with no striking images can still carry its Figure 1 with three stacked bands, why, what and how it is checked, joined by two big chevrons, one accent colour on pale blue, and black silhouettes to tell the scenarios apart.
